name: Camera Anima
source:
[i]Pursue the Artisan, save your sister, and uncover the past, but remember what the stories say…Meet his face, and never wake again.[/i]

On the Floating Isles of Awyr, citizens live in a society where their livelihoods and social status are defined by the masks or "Faces" they wear. Though attitudes are slowly changing towards the Face-system, there are rumors that those who wander the streets at night without a Face become prey to the Artisan, doomed to turn up as a stylistically arranged corpse.

His last known victim was found five years ago, but he’s never been caught. Only Essie truly knows what happened that night.

Explore through her memories to uncover the mystery of the Artisan.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]追寻工匠，拯救你的妹妹，揭开过去，但请记住故事所说的……见到他的脸，就再也不会醒来。[/i]

在艾威尔浮岛上，公民生活在一个他们的生计和社会地位由他们所佩戴的面具或“面孔”决定的社会中。尽管人们对脸部系统的态度正在慢慢改变，但有传言称，那些在夜间在街道上徘徊而没有脸部的人会成为工匠的猎物，注定会以一具风格排列的尸体的形式出现。

他的最后一位已知受害者是五年前被发现的，但他从未被抓获。只有埃西真正知道那天晚上发生了什么。

探索她的记忆，揭开工匠之谜。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334030/]Steam[/url]]
